summary: Dragon's Crown entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Dragon's Crown

emulation.notes: Primary route is native Dragon's Crown Pro. PS3 emulation can preserve the original release, but it is not the recommended main run while Pro remains available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: 4K-compatible PS4 Pro presentation with re-recorded orchestral soundtrack.

primary.why: Dragon's Crown Pro is the highest-fidelity and most complete route: it includes 4K support on PS4 Pro, refined artwork, a re-recorded orchestral soundtrack, dual audio, and gameplay-balance parity with the base version.
primary.how_to_play: Play Dragon's Crown Pro on PS4 Pro or PS5 backward compatibility for the cleanest visual route; use PS3/Vita only for legacy hardware or portable preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Pro is an enhanced port, not a new campaign: it improves presentation and audio while maintaining base-version gameplay balance. PS3/Vita patch 1.08 added cross-play and cross-save compatibility with Pro.
